title: Tar Devils Sociology Symposium
text:
Welcome to the Tar Devils Sociology Symposium webpage!
The third Tar Devils Sociology Symposium will be held January 30, 2027, at Duke University. It will bring together the graduate student researchers at the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill and Duke University.
